environment.B_candidate: font-display:swap with body visibility gate removed

protocol.round_order: For each route: A/B on even rounds, B/A on odd rounds, seven rounds per arm; no retry, resume or skipped samples
protocol.lighthouse_model: Default mobile simulated Slow4G and 4x CPU
protocol.candidate_scope: Only seven local font-face display values changed from block to swap, plus removal of the p25-font-pending body visibility rule. Families, file URLs, font weights, preloads, markup, page copy and assets otherwise match.
protocol.font_decision_rule: Candidate LCP must improve on both routes and CLS must be no worse on either route. No font source change unless both conditions pass.
protocol.analysis: Raw samples only. Do not calculate medians, IQRs, ratios or candidate outcome until the raw file is committed and pushed.
